_metadata.description: Deterministic remediation, scenario-auditor migration accounting, operator workbench, and Test Genie cutover.

requirements.title: Fix registry previews before writing
requirements.description: PreviewFix and ApplyFix are mounted through the shared validation RPC; preview is dry-run, apply requires explicit invocation, and every candidate reports rule_id, file_path, before, after, and applied status.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/autofix/autofix_test.go. Assert dry-run no writes, apply writes expected patch, second apply idempotent, and unsupported rules produce clear messages.

requirements.title: Only unambiguous repairs are auto-fixable
requirements.description: Auto fixes are limited to local mechanical edits; design-bearing changes such as endpoint versioning strategy, error envelope redesign, logging architecture, and context propagation remain manual with explicit reasons.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/fixability_test.go. Cross-check maturity.json fix_class declarations against implemented fixers and manual reasons.

requirements.title: Scenario-auditor API migration is parity-or-better
requirements.description: Each scenario-auditor API rule is accounted for as kept, redesigned, delegated to another provider, deferred, or rejected; migrated findings are compared against fixture scenarios before cutover.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/migration/parity_test.go plus docs/reference/scenario-auditor-api-migration.md. Assert every old API rule ID appears exactly once in the migration ledger.

requirements.title: Operator workbench separates static findings from live evidence
requirements.description: The UI and human CLI reports group findings by capability, show live probe evidence as timestamped evidence rather than static debt, and provide fix previews without writing by default.

validation.notes: Planned refs: ui/src/features/validation/ApiHealthWorkbench.test.tsx and cli/domains/validate/handlers_test.go. Assert grouping, probe evidence labels, and dry-run fix preview copy.
